## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Pilar 7 Bridge Experience, N6 34.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Learn the intricacies of what's been called the prettiest bridge in the world, at the Pilar 7 Bridge Experience. There's hands-on fun, virtual reality and an elevator ride to mind-blowingly beautiful views of Lisbon from the 25 de Abril Bridge.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €6.26. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 123 ratings and 92 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
